relationships.subject: P2X4
relationships.evidence_quote: Trang found that perfusion of ATP evoked P2X4 receptor opening, which caused the release and synthesis of brain-derived neurotrophic factor (BDNF) via activating p38-mitogen-activated protein kinase in cultured primary microglia.

relationships.subject: BDNF
relationships.evidence_quote: BDNF bound to TrkB receptors of excitatory neuron and induced downstream inhibition of KCC2 and GABA receptors

relationships.subject: ATP
relationships.evidence_quote: Kuan found that ATP was released after TH, and the high amounts of ATP acted on microglial P2X7 receptors, promoting IL-1β secretion.

relationships.subject: HMGB1
relationships.evidence_quote: Neutralizing HMGB-1 or antagonizing its well-known receptors toll like receptor (TLR)-4 prevented microglial depolarization, NOS activity and mechanical allodynia.

relationships.subject: HIF-1alpha
relationships.evidence_quote: HIF-1α inhibitors also suppressed the expression of NLRP-3

key_findings: Review: microglia mediate central post-stroke pain via ATP receptors (P2X4, P2X7, Panx-1), chemokine axes (SDF-1/CXCR4, MCP-1/CCR2), HMGB1/TLR4 and HIF-1alpha/NLRP3 signaling.
P2X4-BDNF-TrkB signaling reduces KCC2 and disinhibits thalamic neurons after thalamic hemorrhage.
